hypothesis: Mechanism: pi compacts when context > window - reserveTokens, so 16384 compacts at 65,536 tokens instead of 53,248 (+23% context) and the summary call's max_tokens drops from 16384 to 13107. Fewer compactions per session (29 in W1, 2408 s, 6.8% of wall; 10 timeouts near one): expect compaction_start down, median wall time down slightly, valid and kind-match rates flat or slightly up; risk: context_overflow up when a long reply meets a fuller window.
